cohort: 230 children with allergic rhinitis (AR) and 230 healthy children
finding: The most common allergens in children with AR were house dust mites (inhaled allergens) and shrimp (food allergens), and independent risk factors for AR included asthma, secondhand smoke, being part of a floating population, home decoration within the past 2 years, family history of AR, and having domestic animals.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of AR in children.
